title: LIVE WIRE RUN
style:
124 BPM — Electro-Ocean House

STYLE TAGS

124 BPM, thick sidechained bass,
engine hum texture intro,
bright ocean synth plucks,
gang chorus,
designed for mid-set open water
lyrics:
[INTRO]
Lines off.
Throttle up.

[VERSE]
Steel hull shining in the sun
Live Wire moving — run by run
Open water, horizon wide
Indian Ocean on our side

[CHORUS]
Live Wire run
Feel the wake
WA steel
No mistake

Captain steady
Decks alive
Live Wire pulse
Ocean drive
